fields.basis: Rapid evaluation by team 3 at 10:40 found a failed second-floor bearing wall and a leaning parapet
fields.reentry: Only with the building official's written permission, for life safety or to retrieve essentials with an escort
fields.order: All occupants shall vacate. The owner shall secure the building, keep the public away from the sidewalk side and retain a structural engineer.
fields.howToResolve: Submit an engineer's evaluation and repair plan; request reinspection after the work.
fields.appeal: Written appeal to the board of appeals within 10 days of this order.
